perks.name: Rampage

perks.name: Quickdraw

perks.name: Firmly Planted
perks.desc: Increased accuracy, stability, and handling when firing while crouched.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.desc: Faster time to aim down sights.

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.desc: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.desc: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.desc: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Firing Line

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Collective Action
perks.desc:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: One for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Dawning Surprise
perks.desc: Defeating targets awards a Dawning gift. Defeated powerful targets count as more than one.

perks.name: Suros Synergy
perks.desc: Reloading grants this weapon bonus handling and reduces incoming flinch for a short time.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 126 from 17 December 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/6SVRlV4ttvPkAm9HA44Km0?si=a9d7a25536b747c3) with @ImpetusAlways, @CourtProjects and @Saint_Kabr (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for chunkier add-clearing against Minor Spec Enemies in general, and end-game underleveled content, particularly with a solar build. Avalanche has okay stats, but it is an event weapon so that's to be expected. At base - 50 Range equates to 47.38m when ADS and 29.61m hipfire, 40 Handling is a 0.40s ready 0.41s ADS time and 0.37s stow time, and 55 Reload Speed is a 4.71s reload. Magazine size is 57 (max 8) and with 0/1/2/3 Reserves mods, you'll have total ammo of 361/406/451/473 (max 477) - this has been buffed to match other adaptives, making Avalanche very viable as an LMG option. Arrowhead Brake cleans up the recoil direction to 100, or Smallbore or Fluted Barrel boost useful stats as the barrel perk. Then, Appended Mag or Extended Mag work as mag perks, giving you more shots without reloading. To use as a heavy scout rifle for add-clearing, in the first trait perk column the rounds that Rewind Rounds or Subsistence refills save time on reloads, or Dragonfly is always fun for additional solar detinations on crit kills, while Incandescent helps spread scorch stacks and tie into solar subclass fragments to assist with add-clearing. The Dawning Surprise origin trait is pretty potent for PvE - 6 Minor add rapid kills drops a "gift" for your fireteam which on pickup grants +20% energy to all your abilities, restores 22HP and starts health regeneration. Recommended MW: Range, Stability or Handling, with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Firesprites or when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader.

Panda (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "There's nothing more fun than shooting forever. That's what this machine gun hopes to do. Rewind Rounds will give you ammo right back into the mag allowing for better sustained Target Lock damage." Recommended MW: Stability.

Panda (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Golden Tricorn is goated on this machine gun. A blistering quick 4 shot TtK at 0.40s. You only need to hit 50% of your headshots up to Tier 8 resilience, and if you happen to synergize for Golden Tricorn 2x you can 3 shot 2c1b any resilience at 0.27s." Recommended MW: Range or Stability.

Adamsdown_Boy - information as at v8.0.0.6 PvE / PvE-Boss / PvE-BossSpec / PvE-EndGame / PvE-God / M+KB / Controller): PvE pick for killing boss-tier Subjugators. As per @mossy_max (https://x.com/mossy_max/status/1804893174965338387) - boss-tier Subjugators have a 20% damage reduction to all non-matching damage, going up to 30% DR to all damage after they "screech", which counts as a shield in-game and reacts to shield-based trait perks. Avalanche drops from the Dawning event so, if you haven't already got one, you'll have to wait until it rolls around. First, Arrowhead Brake to help with recoil, or Chambered Compensator or Polygonal Rifling will also to help land consistent crits. Then Tactical Mag with a Backup Mag mod gets you to 75 shots in the mag, or Appended or Extended Mag work too. In the first trait perk column, Under-Over provides a base +50% damage against the boss Subjugator "shield". To boost this further, in the second column, you can choose between Target Lock or Vorpal Weapon as the easiest to set up, or One for All or Adrenaline Junkie if there are any adds around to proc. The Suros Synergy origin trait is briefly useful after a reload, but Dawning Surprise won't do much when firing at Subjugators. Recommended MW: Stability, with a Backup Mag mod

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 91 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/50NPk7xF3Tt6X3DVucE9jU?si=44d2b7d44a5a4aec) with @CourtProjects and @ImpetusAlways. First-choice PvE pick for add-clearing chunkier Minor Spec, and Major Spec enemies in end-game content. The stats are okay overall - there are a could of surprises with 90 Aim Assist and 19 Zoom, which are a lot higher than its peers - but unfortunately Avalanche has the lowest ammo reserves of any adaptive which limits its usefulness. If you already have a decent solar LMG, then you can pass. If you don't, Arrowhead Brake cleans up the recoil direction to 100, or Smallbore or Fluted Barrel boost useful stats as the barrel perk. Then, Appended Mag, Extended Mag or Flared Magwell can all work as mag perks. Finally, the SOFA (Stats/ One For All) traint combination layers on more useful stats and a chunky 35% damage boost for 10s when procced. The Dawning Surprise origin trait is very useful in PvE - when the behind the scenes counter hits 100, the surprise is spawned on the ground for 10s and grants 10% energy to all abilities, grants 20HP and starts shield/health regeneration. Recommended MW: Charge Time, with a damage boosting (Minor, Major or Taken Spec) mod.

With Actium War Rig, Extended Mag, and Rewind Rounds you'll never have to reload before the target is dead. Especially so if you stack on damage from a spec mod and Vorpal Weapon." Recommended MW: Reload.

Panda (PvP / M+KB): "While you don't see many machine guns running around in the crucible, you can with Avalanche. Arrowhead Brake brings up the recoil direction to 100. Adding in either range or stability (or both) with Dynamic Sway Reduction will make the shooting experience enjoyable. Incandescent is a bit of an odd choice but being able to apply some Scorch and make the second kill easier will allow you to go on a nice spree." Recommended MW: Range.

Stallion (PvP / Controller / M+KB): "This weapon is strange in that it doesn't have much for PvP, but the small pool of options is pretty good. pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "I am always both happy and sad when this weapon rolls around. Avalanche is just a relic of year 3. It’s a weird SUROS machine gun that fires from both barrels. The saving grace is being a 450 RPM machine gun. I went slightly different with my recommendations compared to my peers. With a recoil direction of 70 you really want to bump this up to max. Arrowhead brake is the first suggestion I have. With auto-loading holster you won’t have to worry about reload speed and you’ll get all the benefits of a bigger magazine with appended mag. Finally there’s target lock. This season’s newest perk. Target lock will increase your damage the longer you stay on target. With backup mag and appended mag you cap out your magazine at 75. With these many bullets you should definitely be the coolest person in your fireteam when you hit the cap on damage and be able to show off that sweet, sweet DEEPS." Recommended MW - Stability.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB): "Adaptive machine guns have always been my favorite for PvP. Being able to have decent damage at range, good chip damage, and a pretty manageable recoil are all great things to have. Inspired by DMB PvE Podcast 44. PvE first-choice roll for chunkier Minors with a Solar subclass in endgame content. Option of Suros Synergy or the Dawning Surprise origin trait which can help you gain ability energy and restart healing by collecting a small box after killing a half-dozen enemies or so. Balanced stats, so you can use Arrowhead Brake to get straight recoil, or Fluted Barrel for extra Handling and Stability. In the mag slot, we'll be wanting to take full advantage of Ambitious Assassin's 10% bonus mag size per rapid kill after reloading with a size-boosting option. Then use the Target Lock second-column trait to get up to a passive 40% damage boost against a single target just for shooting at it - ideal for Major or Boss damage. Recommended MW: Stability, with a damage-boosting (Major, Boss or Taken Spec) mod.
